output.title: Deadline for a Prescriber to Schedule a Peer-to-Peer Review After a Denial
output.draft_text:
Question: How many days does a prescriber have to schedule a peer-to-peer review after a denial?

Answer: After a prior authorization or coverage request is denied, the prescriber has [number of days] [calendar/business] days from [the date of the denial notice / the date the denial was issued / the date the prescriber received notice] to request and schedule a peer-to-peer review with [the reviewing pharmacist/medical director/clinical reviewer].

How to schedule: The prescriber (or [authorized office staff]) can request a peer-to-peer review by calling [phone number] or [other method, e.g., portal or fax], available [hours of operation]. The prescriber should have [required information, e.g., member ID, denial reference number, drug name] ready.

If the window has passed: If the prescriber misses the [number of days]-day window, [alternative path, e.g., the prescriber or member may submit a formal appeal/redetermination within [number of days] days of the denial].

Exceptions: [Any exceptions, e.g., different timeframes for expedited/urgent requests, specific plans, lines of business, or state requirements].

What to tell the caller: Let the caller know the deadline is counted from [start event], and that requesting a peer-to-peer review [does/does not] extend or pause the deadline to file a formal appeal.
placeholders: [the date of the denial notice / the date the denial was issued / the date the prescriber received notice]
[required information, e.g., member ID, denial reference number, drug name]
[alternative path, e.g., the prescriber or member may submit a formal appeal/redetermination within [number of days] days of the denial]
[Any exceptions, e.g., different timeframes for expedited/urgent requests, specific plans, lines of business, or state requirements]
author_checklist: Confirm the number of days a prescriber has to request/schedule a peer-to-peer review after a denial.
Confirm whether the timeframe is calendar days or business days.
Confirm the event that starts the clock (denial date, notice date, or receipt date).
Confirm who conducts the peer-to-peer review and who may request it on the prescriber's behalf.
Confirm the contact method, phone number, and hours for scheduling.
Confirm the information the prescriber must provide when requesting.
Confirm the alternative process and deadline if the peer-to-peer window is missed.
Confirm whether timeframes differ for expedited/urgent requests, specific plans, lines of business (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, commercial), or state regulations.
Confirm whether requesting a peer-to-peer review affects the formal appeal deadline.
Identify the source policy or contract document and cite it before approval.
Remove any sections or placeholders that do not apply.
